verdicts.reason: A drops almost all of the geometric pattern, leaving a blank white strip with only a tiny colour sliver. 'DEAN COOPER' sits above 'DDG STUDIO PRESENTS', so the reading order is reversed, and the pink dots float off at the far edges. There is also a stray empty frame line on the right, and all the text is crammed into a small, tiny cluster in the centre. B reads left to right, has a sensible flow and keeps a strip of the brand pattern, but it puts the pink 'DEAN COOPER' directly on that busy pink and blue pattern, which hurts contrast. The 'OPENING JANUARY 1' line is illegibly small, and an orphaned frame box with two dots sits on the right.
